Thinking about chopping silage but not sure if it's ready? Bring in a sample or a few plants to our ECG Agronomy team (Doug or Trevor) to get your corn tested for moisture. We have a chopper and cooker at the main office to get you an accurate silage moisture measurement in approximately 30 minutes. See you soon!

Estelline Coop Grain offers various types of contracts to help you achieve your marketing goals. Stop in and we would be more than happy to discuss what options would work best for your operation.
Estelline Coop Grain is utilizing a CFA Input Finance Program for the 2026 Crop Year. This program is available for Seed (0% through Nov 2026), Fertilizer, Chemical, & Feed Purchases. You can register a new account and complete an on-line application at cfas.com. Please contact us with any questions.

Wheat Weakness Extends into the Weekend - October 16, 2026

Cotton Closes the Week with Mixed Trade - October 16, 2026
Cotton futures posted mixed trade on Friday, with contracts down 19 points to 24 points higher. December was down 54 points on the week. Crude oil was up $3.87 per barrel on the session, with the US dollar index $0.255 lower. Weekly CTC data showed managed money adding 1,862 contracts...
Soybeans Slip Lower into the Weekend as Export Buying Continues - October 16, 2026

Corn Falls on Friday as Spec Longs Continue Exit - October 16, 2026
